'''T'Chttrk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[T'kkrpk]] officer in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]]. Her exact age was unknown even to her, since her species started to calculate time according to the Galactic Standard Calendar only after her homeworld's [[Great Reconciliation]] circa [[95 BBY]]; by this time she had already long been adult and a hereditary officer in the planet's defense force. Since her language was unintelligible to members of other species, she used a [[D-series protocol droid]], [[D-P4M]] as an interpreter.

Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], she served in the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] as the captain of a ship in the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kalback]]. She participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]].
